Legacy Address

Kadri has been Mangalore's Preferred Residential Address for Three Generations.

Buying a home in Kadri area has historically been one of the most preferred choices for Mangalore's established families due to its social infrastructure, cultural landmarks and established communities that no other surrounding area can replicate.

  • Kadri Manjunath Temple — one of the region's oldest temples, with centuries of continuous pilgrimage tradition
  • Kadri Park — Mangalore's largest public garden.
  • KPT Junction — one of the city's key commercial nodes
  • KMC Hospital and several leading schools, all within close reach

This kind of diverse social infrastructure has sustained steady residential demand in Kadri across every economic cycle. Kadri has a level of infrastructure that's hard to find in Mangalore's single-driver growth corridors.

Design Philosophy

Vaastu-Compliant 3 BHK Apartment Design

Vaastu compliance is a non-negotiable checklist item for families from Tulu-speaking coastal Karnataka. Udbhav Chinmaya's explicit Vaastu compliance design addresses this preference directly. The apartment layouts have been designed with Vaastu-prescribed layout orientation, room placement, entry direction and proportions. Track Record

Udbhav Developers Mangalore Track Record

Udbhav Developers was established in 2012 by a Kadri-based entrepreneur named Mr. Kiran BK, a qualified civil engineer with over two decades of domestic and international real estate development experience. Now with a focus on premium small-format projects in Kadri-Mangalore.

Udbhav Developers has delivered some of the landmark structures across Mangalore, including Udbhav Shanthi (Completion 2023), Udbhav Square (Kottara), KRK Aayush (2022), Marcel's Maison (2025) & Bhaskar Coconut Groves (2015).

Specifications & Features of Chinmaya Flats In Kadri Mangalore

Udbhav Chinmaya Kadri is Mangalore's new & premium housing society. Take a look at some of the features & specifications of Udbhav Chinmaya:

Structure & Walls

  • Framed structure built with reinforced cement concrete (RCC).
  • External walls constructed using laterite stone with double plastering.
  • Internal walls built with concrete blocks.

Flooring & Wall Cladding

  • Superior flooring quality 800x800 mm vitrified tiles.
  • Bathroom walls built with Ceramic tiles running up to ceiling height.
  • Bathroom flooring: Designer 600x1200 mm ceramic tiles.
  • Lobbies & Corridors: Finished with granite, Italian marble, or vitrified tiles.
  • Staircase steps: Fitted with 1200x300 mm anti-slip tiles.

Doors & Windows

  • Main door frame: Hardwood frame with an attractive Melamine Polished main door.
  • Main door lock: Equipped with a secure digital lock.
  • Internal doors: Fitted with Masonite door shutters and designer locks.
  • Washroom doors: Built with a Granite/WPC frame and water-resistant FRP shutters.
  • Windows: Aluminium/UPVC glazed windows equipped with MS safety grills and mosquito mesh.

Plumbing & Sanitary

  • Plumbing lines: Superior quality, ISI-certified CPVC/UPVC pressure-tested lines and fittings.
  • Toilets: Equipped with Jaguar or equivalent make EWC (European Water Closet).
  • Bathroom provisions: Plumbing ready for water heaters/geysers.

Electrical & Communication

  • Wiring: Premium Finolex, RR, or equivalent brand electrical wiring.
  • Air conditioning: AC points provided in all bedrooms and halls.
  • Media & Telecom: Telephone and cable TV points installed in the living room and master bedroom.
  • Bathroom electricals: Dedicated geyser points and exhaust fan provisions.

Kitchen Features

  • Counter & Sink: Granite countertop fitted with a stainless steel (SS) single-bowl sink and drainboard.
  • Wall cladding: Ceramic tiles extending 2 feet above the granite counter.
  • Appliances: Sufficient electrical points to accommodate all kitchen appliances.
  • Utility provisions: Dedicated points for an exhaust fan, RO water purifier, instant geyser, and chimney.
  • Gas supply: Piped gas connection via GAIL pipeline.

Paint & Finishes

  • Internal surfaces built by premium emulsion paint over a smooth putty finish on walls and ceilings.
  • External surfaces: Coated with external-grade, antifungal superior paint.
  • Metalwork: All metal fixtures and fabrications coated with enamel paint.

High Security

  • CCTV camera monitoring across all floors.
  • Access control: Biometric access control systems for common areas.
  • Apartment security: Video door phones paired with main door digital locks.
  • Power reliability: 100% power backup for both individual apartments and common areas.

Sustainability & Accessibility

  • Green solar-powered lighting installed for common areas.
  • Motion sensors installed for common passage lighting to save energy.
  • Water conservation: Integrated rainwater harvesting system.
  • Green mobility: Dedicated EV charging provisions for each car parking space.
  • Inclusivity: Wheelchair-friendly main lobby design.

FAQ

Frequently Ask Questions About 3 BHK Flats In Kadri, Mangalore

1. Where can I find a 3 BHK flat for sale in Kadri?

You can find premium 3 BHK flats for sale in Kadri, Mangalore through direct developer listings or established real estate portals. If you want a low-density, premium option, Udbhav Chinmaya offers exclusive, ultra-spacious 3 BHK configurations (1,715 to 1,880 sq. ft.) located in the quiet residential corridor of Chandrika Layout, Swami Vivekananda Road in Kadri.

2. Is it worth buying a 3 BHK luxury flat in Kadri?

Yes, buying a 3 BHK luxury flat in Kadri is highly worth it due to steady capital appreciation, special infrastructure & excellent coastal connectivity.

3. What are some good 3 BHK flats for sale in Mangalore?

Good 3 BHK flats for sale in Mangalore should balance generous square footage, high-end construction materials, and a low-density layout. While massive high-rises are common, boutique low-rise developments like Udbhav Chinmaya in Kadri stand out by providing premium 3 BHK spaces featuring zero shared common walls, Vaastu-compliant architectural layouts, and dedicated resort-style amenities shared among only 40 families.

4. Is Udbhav Chinmaya RERA approved?

Yes, Udbhav Chinmaya is fully RERA approved and legally registered with the Karnataka Real Estate Regulatory Authority. The project complies completely with all construction milestones, structural engineering guidelines, and financial transparency standards mandated under regional regulatory law.

6. Are the lifestyle and fitness amenities shared with outside visitors?

No. All premium lifestyle amenities—including the rooftop infinity swimming pool, elite multi-purpose party hall, fully-equipped gym, and kids zone—are completely private and restricted strictly to residents and their personal guests, preserving low-density quietness and community security.

How is Kadri, Mangalore for buying a home?

Kadri is a luxury locality to buy an apartment, as compared to other areas in the surrounding areas. This locality ranks Along NH-66. Some of the popular features of Kadri are:

  • Employment Zones Nearby
  • Close to Railway Station
  • Proximity to Hospitals

Is kadri real estate sustainable?

Yes it is. It is a structural premium supported by land scarcity (no large undeveloped land parcels remain in central Kadri), social infrastructure density (no peripheral zone can match it for decades), and cultural-heritage proximity (Kadri Manjunath Temple is not relocatable).
